scripts.build:mac: sh -c 'if [ -n "$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY" ]; then exec tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin; else exec tauri build --target universal-apple-darwin --no-sign; fi'
scripts.build:mac:debug: sh -c 'if [ -n "$APPLE_SIGNING_IDENTITY" ]; then exec tauri build --debug --target universal-apple-darwin; else exec tauri build --debug --target universal-apple-darwin --no-sign; fi'
